title: Vapor: Redis 6.x Clusters Are Now Available
content: <html><head></head><body>Starting today, in addition to Redis 5.x Clusters, you may now also create and manage Redis 6.x Clusters. Redis 6.x is the latest version of open-source Redis software. This new version brings improved security and boosts the performance of your cache.</body></html>
author: Nuno Maduro
